summary: 30 units reviewed; 9 units marked fix, 23 issues (1 error, 22 minor), 21 with machine patches. Error: 27 Hindi gives the ally as the agent of prārthayitvā while the English (correctly) gives the king. Minor: vīvadha read as 'supply line' (puruṣa-vīvadha = supply of men, matching anabhisāra) in 1 and 14; 16 Hindi adds 'दूष्यों को' as object of asaṃhatam, which describes the army; 23 'vikrītam abhiyuñjāne' should be 'sold to the attacker' (locative of buyer); 29 friend -> ally per glossary; 19 genitive gloss. Items needing a person: 8.5.2 'aniyatayor' (drafter's flag kept as 'possible'; cannot be settled from the e-text), 8.5.28 parse of 'śaktito' (with mānitam or with nivāritam), 8.5.29 'bhedituṃ' (irregular form; bheditaṃ suspected). Drafter's 8.5.4 flag dūra.āyatam -> dūra.āyātam agreed. 8.5.9 antar-amitram agreed (the e-text's dot is its own segmentation). 8.5.26 'bhaṅktvā param upasthitam' with the ally as subject of both agreed, confidence medium is honest. No regrouping suggested. Hindi contains no brackets or Latin letters. GLOSSARY.md extended with 8.5 terms.
